keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Mansfeld row). The page gives no area, no population and no capital; it says the Mansfelds 'held extended fiefs both in the Archbishopric of Magdeburg and the Bishopric of Halberstadt'. A 22 km circle at 11.50E 51.55N (about 1,520 km2) is a soft stand-in.

New keyframe: Heldrungen 'purchased in 1479' (8 km circle at 11.27E 51.30N) and Allstedt 'acquired by Count Albert VII of Mansfeld in 1526' (8 km circle at 11.39E 51.40N), both soft; the Allstedt circle is drawn from 1479 for simplicity and the 1526 gain is entered in the ledger.

ledger.note: 1069: the counts. 'Emperor Henry IV appointed the loyal House of Mansfeld counts' in 1069, after the revolt led by Dedi I (infobox '1069-1580'); Hoyer I was killed at Welfesholz on 11 February 1115 and 'the male line became extinct for the first time upon the death of Count Burchard of Mansfeld in 1229'.
1526: Allstedt. It was 'acquired by Count Albert VII of Mansfeld in 1526.' (Albert VII was banned by Charles V after the Battle of Mühlberg in 1547.)

1580: mediatised. 'The family's assets were confiscated in 1579' and the county lost 'imperial comital status, and also sovereignty' (footnote: 1580); it was 'mediatized between the Electorate of Saxony and the Archbishopric of Magdeburg', after the creditors had sequestrated it (agreements of 15 March and 5 July 1574).

certainty.note: The page gives no area or boundary; the circles are stand-ins.

notes:
Written 2026-10-25 for batch eu-09-x (1 page; budget 1-2). New state: Cliopatria has no Mansfeld row.

SCOPE. Infobox 1069-1580. The county joined the Upper Saxon Circle in 1512 as an immediate Imperial estate; the lines Hinterort, Mittelort and Vorderort (15th century, tables 1540 and 1560-1580) are kept inside one state; Mittelort and Hinterort died out in 1602 and 1666 and the Vorderort line in 1780 ('their fiefs fell back to the Electorate of Saxony and the Prussian Duchy of Magdeburg'). The Peasants' War of 1525 and Frankenhausen (Albert VII on the imperial side) are named without a boundary effect. The Mansfeld Feud of 1479 and the Hettstedt, 1420 and 1501 items are not on the page.

SHAPES. Mansfeld 11.50E 51.55N 22 km; Heldrungen 11.27E 51.30N 8 km; Allstedt 11.39E 51.40N 8 km. Gazetteer names wanted: 'Mansfeld', 'Eisleben', 'Heldrungen', 'Allstedt', 'Artern'.

NOT SETTLED. (1) No area, no capital; (2) the end: 1579 (confiscation) against 1580 (footnote); (3) the share of the Archbishopric of Magdeburg in 1580 is not drawn; (4) the Bohemian possessions (Dobris, 1630) are outside.
